q: What kind of wife did Yahweh tell Hosea to take for himself?
a: Yahweh told him to marry a prostitute.

q: Why will Israel (the prostitute) return to her first husband?
a: She will return to her first husband because she thinks it was better for her then than now.

q: In that day, what will Israel (the prostitute) call Yahweh?
a: She will call him “My Husband,” and no longer “My Baal.”

q: In what way must Hosea love his wife?
a: Hosea must love her just as Yahweh loves the people of Israel.

q: For how much did Hosea buy back his wife?
a: He bought her for fifteen pieces of silver and 335 liters of barley.

q: What does Hosea tell his wife she must not do?
a: Hosea tells his wife that she must not be a prostitute and must not have sex with any other man.

q: What sins does Yahweh say the people are committing?
a: The people are cursing, lying, murdering, stealing, and committing adultery.

q: Although Yahweh hurt his people, what will he then do?
a: Although he hurt them, he will heal them and bind up their wounds.
